entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After arguing the matter for sufficient length of time, learned counsel for the petitioners files a memo seeking withdrawal of the petition.

The said memo reads as under:
" MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL
In the above said case petitioners have filed above criminal petition seeking to quash FIR and complaint.
In view of prayer sought above is premature one as the matter is still shall under investigation.
Therefore, petitioners craves leave of this Hon'ble Court to assail charge sheet if any filed in future by respondent No.1 police."
Place the aforesaid memo on record, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn, with liberty as prayed for.
